visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short dark hair, wearing a black sleeveless athletic top and dark navy blue shorts, stands in a gym-like corridor. He is barefoot and forcefully slams two thick black battle ropes onto the grey floor in an alternating rhythmic motion. His facial expression is one of intense focus and physical exertion. (2) He continues the high-intensity rope exercise, his body weight shifting as he maintains a athletic squat stance. To his right, a bright yellow wall features large white text marking facility rooms. The environment is lit with industrial-style overhead lights, and yellow pipes are visible along the ceiling. (3) The camera pans to the left, showing a black treadmill positioned against the wall and a light grey floor surface before quickly panning back to the man. He maintains his pace, the ropes creating blurred arcs in the air due to the speed of movement. (4) The man performs a final few slams before slowing his motion as the set concludes. He remains in the center of the frame, his posture reflecting the end of a high-energy physical task. The camera remains steady on his upper body as the video ends.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-intensity, rapid percussive thuds as battle ropes slam rhythmically against the floor. An off-screen male coach provides high-arousal vocal encouragement in Mandarin, shouting with an excited and authoritative tone. There is no BGM, leaving the sound of the impacts as the primary rhythmic element. (2) The rhythmic thudding continues at a consistent tempo. The athlete's heavy breathing is audible in the background, adding to the soundscape of physical exertion. The coach's voice maintains its intensity, periodically shouting motivational phrases with sharp pitch variability to keep the energy high. (3) A sequence of percussive impacts is followed by the coach initiating a rhythmic countdown in Mandarin, starting from 'three'. The vocal projection is strong, clearly cutting through the broadband noise of the rope hits. The room acoustics provide a slight indoor resonance. (4) The countdown concludes with a final loud percussive rope slam and the sound of the athlete exhaling deeply. The rapid thudding stops, transitioning into a short period of ambient room tone and the coach's lower-arousal concluding remarks. The audio fidelity remains clear throughout the field recording.
